scope: Official Web host completion counters and native retained UI unsupported gate; focused source checks before final combined SDK/browser validation.

checks.environment: CARGO_HOME/RUSTUP_HOME/PATH/LIBRARY_PATH as native-validation.json; debug test profile; no release proc-macro overrides.

counter_contract.completion: Explicit completed outcomes from world renderer, Canvas UI and required cursor, after synchronous submissions; no GPU/compositor scanout acknowledgement.
counter_contract.publication_timestamp: Main-host acceptance of already-decoded snapshot; performance.timeOrigin included, not worker serialization time.
counter_contract.reset: Successful new project load/restart starts a metrics session; interpolation-only resets do not. Dropped steps are relative to the scheduler total at that session start.
counter_contract.storage: 512 numeric intervals; no per-frame report arrays/sorting. Queries construct detached frozen reports and never invoke runtime/worker commands.

independent_review.result: No concrete P1/P2 in completion helper/main/cursor/export glue, including session-relative dropped-step follow-up.

limits: The combined actual Canvas/renderer pending/failure/context-loss and final SDK browser execution remain separate validations.
No benchmark or full native support was run; native retained content/transform rejects before preparation/painting.
Earlier native artifacts remain untouched. No 60FPS, zeroGC, finalcommit or universal memory-leak certification follows from these tests.

startup_followup.scope: Actual main startup entry with real Canvas asset readiness in ordinary/checked modes; unknown outcome rejection, no READY/completed draws/scheduler while images pending, no RAF polling during asset waits, final-barrier cursor freshness, cursor retirement/disposal.
startup_followup.limits: Controlled host/renderer fixtures; actual exported browser/SDK remains separate.
